desc:
Welcome to The Whispering Wild: Wolf RPG!
The world of adventure awaits, where you live, explore, and survive as a wolf. Roam around in the land of wolves.. Every howl tells a story, what will yours be? 🐺🌿

🐺 Become a Wolf ~ Design your own wolf
🦌 Hunt for Food ~ Track prey, survive, and help your pack eat
👨‍👩‍👧 Raise a Family ~ Find a mate, raise pups, and protect your family
🌲 Explore the World ~ Travel through forests, mountains, and hidden places
🐾 Join a Pack ~ Team up with other wolves and hunt together
⚔️ Battle Rival Packs ~ Protect your territory and fight enemies
🌙 Create Your Story ~ Roleplay, make friends, and build your own wolf life
